state: Verified context: Rent currently materializes a locked full resource evidence object at 55 authored points, including every report-relevant booking and venue along with opening-window and downtime lists. Each capture uses server admission now and a per-resource sequence. quote_accept writes one after creating a booking and another after changing its status in that same admission. Reports use greatest eligible sequence at each segment boundary, combine independently saved location calendar policies, and return exact booked/occupied/saleable/excluded duration contributions with room/seat units and provisional unclosed occupancy. Unknown initial coverage remains partial. A reservation-manager plus present work-location permission controls the authority report; evidence access is restricted. No saved-resource retention deadline is specified. Sequentially adding B bookings while copying the growing list implies B(B+1)/2 value occurrences before further updates, not an empirical storage or timing measurement. Intermediate snapshots may be coalesced only after verifying that no call/output/event observes them; invocation time does not advance. Automatic record history currently supplies UI audit, not a specified temporal query helper. A normalized set of ordinary locked entity revisions is expressible if capture coverage, identity, absence and temporal joins are supplied. The language is a draft with no implementation compatibility gate. Choose a complete representation under equal requirements for old intervals, DST, changed policy, cancelled service, late occupancy, current disclosure and partial-history truth; never rewrite financial or reversal behavior or quietly discard old evidence.

history.instructions: Which alternative provides the best overall fit for this historical-report obligation?

criteria.explicit_facts: Retain history as normal locked records: one small resource capture and per-identity changed-value revisions for each report collection. Reconstruct state by latest revision before the chosen capture and define baseline/absence explicitly. It saves unrelated value repetition without a new primitive, in exchange for explicit multi-site capture coverage and more complicated historical selection.
criteria.version_query: Introduce a checked temporal read facility backed by transaction-final selected-field versions. It must pin entity disappearance, chronological ties, current grants, retained intervals and missing coverage before reports use it. Automatic capture can shorten applications, but an audit screen alone does not implement this new general historical contract.
criteria.full_coalesced: Preserve the full-state history representation and narrow the change to removing intermediate same-admission captures after proving they cannot be observed. Reconstruction stays simple and all retained history remains available. The cumulative cross-admission value growth remains a documented operational cost rather than being fixed by this edit.
